title: HALTT: A HAte Lexicon Through Time
abstract: arXiv:2611.25862v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated hate speech detection degrades over time as everyday vocabulary is weaponized into covert slurs while retaining original benign meanings (polysemy retention). Existing lexical semantic change detection (LSCD) frameworks struggle with this phenomenon due to a lack of standardized, sense-delineated diachronic resources. We propose a multi-stage framework to construct and validate a diachronic lexicon of semantically shifted hate speech terms. Filtering > 20,000 candidates, our pipeline combines historical (1770-1964) and modern (2001-2024) corpus frequency grounding, masked definition-level scoring to mitigate LLM temporal bias, and a dual-persona reasoning prompt paradigm. We release HALTT, a grounded lexicon of 19 polysemous terms with literal and derogatory senses, analyze shift typologies, and establish evaluation protocols for downstream diachronic benchmarking.

translated_title: HALTT：一个随时间演变的仇恨词汇词典
translated_abstract: 自动化仇恨言论检测的效果会随时间推移而下降，因为日常词汇会被“武器化”为隐蔽的贬义用语，同时保留其原本的中性含义（多义性保留）。现有的词汇语义变化检测（LSCD）框架由于缺乏标准化的、区分词义的历时性资源，难以应对这一现象。我们提出了一个多阶段框架，用于构建和验证一个收录了发生语义偏移的仇恨言论词汇的历时性词典。我们的流程筛选了超过 20,000 个候选词，结合了历史（1770-1964）与现代（2001-2024）语料库频率校准、掩码定义级评分以缓解大语言模型的时间偏差，以及双角色推理提示范式。我们发布了 HALTT——一个包含 19 个具有字面义和贬义的多义词的、有语料依据的词典，分析了语义偏移的类型学，并为下游的历时性基准测试建立了评估协议。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个多阶段框架，构建并发布了首个收录19个多义仇恨词汇的历时性词典HALTT，以应对日常词汇被武器化为隐蔽贬义用语而导致的仇恨言论检测性能随时间下降的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-stage framework to construct and release HALTT, a grounded diachronic lexicon of 19 polysemous hate speech terms, addressing the degradation of automated hate speech detection caused by everyday vocabulary being weaponized into covert slurs over time.
